registeredReadTools.name: meta_load_skill
registeredReadTools.description: Load a skill from the internal library by name (from meta_search_skills). Returns the full procedure to follow, plus the tools it references.

registeredReadTools.name: meta_search_skills
registeredReadTools.description: Search the internal skill library for an operating procedure matching the seller's question — how to diagnose, optimize, clean up, plan or review something (怎么优化/怎么排查/为什么涨了/该怎么做). Returns candidate skills with descriptions; load the best one with meta_load_skill. Use for operational or advisory questions, AND for multi-step analyses (weekly review, profit/fee audit, reimbursement recovery, clearance decisions, traffic triage) — those have tested SQL playbooks here. Skip it only for simple one-shot statistics, which go straight to data_query.

registeredReadTools.description:
查询一个或多个 ASIN 近 7 天流量得分，包含自然流量、广告流量和环比变化。

Use when:
    用户想快速判断商品流量强弱、自然/广告流量占比、近 7 天流量变化，或对一批 ASIN 做流量体检。
    如果用户已经提供多个 ASIN，优先放在同一次 asins 列表中调用，减少重复请求。

    每个ASIN的流量得分详情：自然流量得分、广告流量得分、总得分、关键词数量、
    环比增长率、自然/广告流量占比等。
